name: VET Point Spawning
definition: A process to add points to a point cloud based on a visual error volume to improve neural rendering quality. It uses a normalized error value $e_i$ and a maximum number of points per voxel $p_{max}$.
summary: VET Point Spawning adds points to a cloud based on a visual error volume, avoiding the aggressive thresholding and memory bloat of naive strategies by spawning directly within error-weighted voxels.
